API Gateway Authentication Bypass [Spoofing, Elevation of Privilege, CWE-287] on APIGateway, CloudFront, IAM: Attackers might exploit overly permissive IAM policies or use compromised credentials to bypass API Gateway authentication. An attacker obtains AWS credentials with broad permissions and uses them to bypass API Gateway authentication controls.

Sensitive Data Exposure in S3 [Information Disclosure, Tampering, CWE-311] on S3, DataLakeBucket, MlModelsBucket: Attackers might exploit misconfigured bucket policies, IAM roles, or encryption settings to access sensitive data. An attacker gains access to ML models or transaction data through overly permissive bucket policies or compromised IAM credentials.

ML Model Tampering [Tampering, Repudiation, CWE-494] on SageMaker, Lambda, S3: Attackers might attempt to poison the ML model during training or deployment, or launch adversarial attacks against the model. An attacker manipulates training data or model artifacts to reduce the accuracy of fraud detection.

Transaction Data Stream Manipulation [Tampering, Information Disclosure, CWE-20] on Kinesis, Lambda, API Gateway: Attackers might attempt to inject malformed data into the Kinesis stream or intercept stream data. An attacker manipulates transaction data in the stream to bypass fraud detection rules.

Database Credential Exposure [Information Disclosure, Elevation of Privilege, CWE-522] on RDS, ElastiCache, Secrets Manager, Lambda: Attackers might attempt to extract database credentials from environment variables, logs, or through application vulnerabilities. An attacker gains access to RDS credentials stored in Secrets Manager through a compromised Lambda function.

Denial of Service Attack [Denial of Service, CWE-400] on CloudFront, API Gateway, Lambda, Kinesis: Attackers might attempt to overwhelm system resources through various DDoS attack vectors. An attacker launches a large-scale DDoS attack against the API endpoints to disrupt fraud detection capabilities.

Insufficient Monitoring and Logging [Repudiation, CWE-778] on CloudWatch, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Lambda: Insufficient logging and monitoring could allow attackers to operate undetected or cover their tracks. An attacker performs reconnaissance and initial access attempts without detection due to inadequate logging.
